options.name: _faked_session
options.description: An internal parameter used for testing the module.

options.name: hmc_auth
options.description: The authentication credentials for the HMC.

options.name: hmc_host
options.description: The hostnames or IP addresses of a single HMC or of a list of redundant HMCs. A single HMC can be specified as a string type or as an HMC list with one item. An HMC list can be specified as a list type or as a string type containing a Python list representation. The first available HMC of a list of redundant HMCs is used for the entire execution of the module.

options.name: log_file
options.description: File path of a log file to which the logic flow of this module as well as interactions with the HMC are logged. If null, logging will be propagated to the Python root logger.

options.name: method
options.description: The HTTP method to be executed, in lower case.

options.name: request_body
options.description: The request body for the HTTP request. Only permitted for C(method=post).

options.name: uri
options.description: The canonical URI of the targeted resource starting with '/api/', including any query parameters.
